primitives.name: StateSet
primitives.statement: There is a set S of states.

primitives.name: HistorySet
primitives.statement: There is a set H of candidate histories.

primitives.name: SourceTarget
primitives.statement: Each history has source and target maps s,t:H->S.
primitives.operational_definition: Two functions from H to S.

primitives.name: HistoryAdmissibility
primitives.statement: Each history has an admissibility predicate AH:H->{0,1}.

definitions.name: InducedRelation
definitions.statement: xRy iff there exists admissible h with s(h)=x and t(h)=y.

definitions.name: CanonicalHistoryEncoding
definitions.statement: For a directed relation R, set H_R=R with source and target equal to first and second projections.

claims.statement: Every typed-history system induces a directed relation.
Every directed relation has a canonical typed-history encoding whose induced relation is exactly the original relation.
Primitive source/target orientation reintroduces directed relational structure and therefore does not by itself satisfy the anti-smuggling compression goal.
A compositional-process primitive may add constrained structure that is not recoverable from the induced one-step relation alone.

observables.name: InducedEdge
observables.definition: Whether at least one admissible history connects x to y.

falsifiers.condition: Produce a binary directed relation for which the canonical pair-history construction fails to recover the relation exactly.

metadata.purpose: Test whether typed histories genuinely compress directed relation structure.
